geometry.derivation: Earth radius inferred by inverse-projecting the provider boundary-box edge within one 1 km source pixel.

time_semantics: DPSRI filename timestamps are Asia/Singapore local time; checked against matching official API timestamp.
transparent_semantics: No visible colored rain return; represented as category 0 with below-detection quality, not as a quantitative zero rainfall rate.
missing_semantics: Pixels beyond the nominal 240 km radius are outside coverage; a slideshow with no frame is NoDataError. Internal transparent pixels cannot distinguish below-threshold from unobserved returns.
